name: bandwar-website
description: Bandwar — A Village Archive. Community-built digital archive of Bandwar village, Begusarai, Bihar. Static site + server-side PDF generation.
author: Bandwar Village Community

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run build:site && npm run build:sitemaps
scripts.build:full: npm run optimize-images && npm run build && npm run build:manifesto
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && echo 'Cleaned dist/'
